title: Are Word Embedding Methods Stable and Should We Care About It?
reasoning: The paper evaluates the stability of static word embeddings (Word2Vec, GloVe, fastText). While it includes a 'Fairness Evaluation Task' using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) to measure social bias, this is used as a technical metric to study the impact of embedding instability rather than to evaluate religion, faith, morals, or theology.
